what: The configurations that scorers READ and then publish constants for (balayage of the scorers, 2026-10-30, class 1). For the targets below at least one of the three admin sub-scores is a value fixed by hand (listed in `fixed_subscores` of each pin; data/finding_2026-09-18-scorers-hardcoded-score-literals.md): if the configuration changes, the notes change and that sub-score does not. Spark is the partial case: its admin and multisig sub-scores are constants, its timelock sub-score is computed from the live delay (and the ALMProxy scorer has a branch that scores 20/0/0 on a divergence). scripts/check_scorer_pins.py reads each configuration live and compares it to what the scorer's own documentation says it was when the constants were chosen. A difference is a reason to re-score by hand; it is not a verdict. The scorers are not changed by this file.
baseline: documented: the values are those written in the docstring of each scorer (scripts/lib/scorers.py) at the time its constants were set, not a reading of the chain. The first run of `check_scorer_pins.py --update` on a machine allowed to read the chain writes the live values, the head block of each chain (`snapshot_blocks`) and the time (`snapshot_utc`) as a dated snapshot.
